title: 第17章 我的钱想怎么花就怎么花-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》
content:
第(1/3)页

    刘老四盯着他看了足足十秒钟。

    他混了这么多年，见过狠的，见过愣的，见过不要命的，但没见过这种。

    不吵不闹，不动手，不骂人，就那么安安静静地坐着，一句一句地把你的底牌全翻出来。

    然后告诉你：我不想跟你打，但你要打，我奉陪。

    这种人最可怕。

    因为他不冲动，他动脑子。

    刘老四把烟头扔在地上，用脚碾灭，转身走了。

    二彪愣在原地，看看林国强，又看看刘老四的背影，追了上去。

    “舅，就这么算了？”

    刘老四没理他，大步流星地走了。

    第二天，刘老四的摊子往后挪了挪，回到了原来的位置。

    第三天，又往后挪了半米。

    到了第五天，刘老四的摊子直接挪到了农机厂大门对面马路牙子上，跟林国强之间隔了整整一条街。

    他的生意一落千丈。

    原来还能靠位置优势截点客流，现在位置没了，味道又比不上林国强的，工人根本不买账。

    一天下来，卖不出二十个。

    又过了三天，刘老四的摊子不见了。

    胖嫂说，他去了镇东头的砖瓦厂门口摆摊去了。

    临走那天，刘老四远远地看了林国强一眼。

    那眼神里有不甘和恼怒，但更多的是……一种说不清道不明的忌惮。

    胖嫂凑过来，竖了个大拇指：“大兄弟，你可真行。

    刘老四折腾来折腾去，没少欺负人，谁都没治住他，你几句话就给弄走了。”

    林国强笑了笑，没说话。

    他知道，他不是靠“几句话”把刘老四弄走的。

    他靠的是信息。

    他花了三天时间，把刘老四的底细摸得一清二楚。

    然后在他最在意的地方……他的“关系”和“底牌”，精准地敲了一锤子。

    这一锤子不重，但敲在了七寸上。

    刘老四不怕吵架、不怕打架、不怕闹事，但他怕被人掀桌子。

    他的摊子经不起查，他的关系经不起推敲。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Liu Laosi stared at him for a full ten seconds.

He has been around for so many years and has seen ruthless people, stunned people, and life-threatening people, but he has never seen this kind.

Don’t make any noise, don’t make a move, don’t curse, just sit quietly and reveal all your trump cards one sentence at a time.

Then I tell you: I don’t want to fight with you, but if you want to fight, I will accompany you.

This kind of person is the most terrifying.

Because he is not impulsive, he uses his brain.

Liu Laosi threw the cigarette butt on the ground, crushed it with his foot, turned around and left.

Er Biao froze on the spot, looked at Lin Guoqiang, then at Liu Laosi's back, and chased after him.

"Uncle, just forget it?"

Liu Laosi ignored him and strode away.

The next day, Liu Laosi’s stall moved back and returned to its original location.

On the third day, I moved back half a meter.

On the fifth day, Liu Laosi’s stall moved directly to the curb opposite the gate of the agricultural machinery factory, separated by a whole street from Lin Guoqiang.

His business plummeted.

原来还能靠位置优势截点客流，现在位置没了，味道又比不上林国强的，工人根本不买账。

At the end of the day, I couldn’t sell twenty.

Three more days later, Liu Laosi’s stall disappeared.

Fat Sister-in-law said that he went to set up a stall in front of the brick and tile factory in the east end of the town.

On the day before leaving, Liu Laosi glanced at Lin Guoqiang from a distance.

There was unwillingness and anger in those eyes, but more importantly...an indescribable fear.

The fat sister-in-law came over and gave a thumbs up: "Brother, you are really good.

Liu Laosi was tossing around, bullying people a lot, but no one was able to control him, and you got rid of him with just a few words."

Lin Guoqiang smiled and said nothing.

He knew that he didn’t get Liu Laosi away with just “a few words”.

He relies on information.

It took him three days to find out all about Liu Laosi.

Then, he struck a precise blow at the place he cared about most...his "relationship" and "trump card."

The hammer was not heavy, but it struck seven inches.

Liu Laosi is not afraid of quarrels, fights, or making trouble, but he is afraid of being kicked off the table.

His business cannot withstand inspection, and his relationship cannot withstand scrutiny.
